note: Hand-researched Charlotte HVAC prospects. Every row was read on the company's own site in a browser; nothing was bulk-exported from Google Maps. Ratings/reviews are a snapshot and drift.

prospects.trigger: Main call to action says Schedule Now, but the button opens no calendar and no booking flow. After the form is submitted the site promises nothing about how fast anyone replies.
prospects.gap: A bookable next step behind every form and chat message: instant acknowledgment, AI triage of the request, self-booking link, human escalation for no-heat emergencies.

prospects.trigger: The service-request form is advertised but does not render (blank area, script errors), and the page copy still tells customers they can chat live with us, though no chat widget exists.
prospects.gap: Repair and instrument the intake: working form, acknowledgment in under a minute, AI summary to the office, text-back booking link.

prospects.trigger: One Request HVAC Service Online form takes email, phone and when service is needed, but there is no immediate confirmation, no self-scheduling and no chat.
prospects.gap: Turn the form into a booked visit: instant acknowledgment, AI categorization by issue and urgency, a queue the office works through in order.

prospects.trigger: Every scheduling button (Schedule Now, Request Appointment) dead-ends on the contact page, and the site's only promise is that they respond promptly to every inquiry.
prospects.gap: Give the customer a real next step: an acknowledgment with a stated time, AI triage, and self-booking so promptly becomes something the customer can see.

prospects.trigger: A blanket We will get back to you within 24 hours promise, with a chat bubble and a form but no way to self-schedule after hours.
prospects.gap: Cut the acknowledgment to seconds and put a booking link in the reply, so the 24-hour promise becomes a booked appointment.

prospects.trigger: Open 7:30am to midnight, seven days a week, with no self-scheduling and no response time stated anywhere on the contact page.
prospects.gap: Night-shift coverage: every inquiry acknowledged instantly and routed, so an 11pm request does not sit until morning.

prospects.trigger: Already runs online booking and a text-us chat bubble, but the form page only promises that someone will get in touch shortly, and the 24/7 claim does not match 8am-5pm office hours.
prospects.gap: The gap left after a booking tool: the request that arrives at 7pm and nobody answers. Acknowledgment plus an estimate follow-up cadence.

prospects.trigger: No request form found on the homepage or contact page, and the Schedule Now button does not open a scheduler. Email is hidden behind an obfuscation tag.
prospects.gap: Capture the after-hours inquiry that currently has to call: form or text-back intake with instant acknowledgment and AI triage.

prospects.trigger: A Get Your Free Estimate form works, but Book Now opens Housecall Pro and the page says there is nothing to book right now. Every visitor who wanted a time slot is lost.
prospects.gap: A booking path that cannot show an empty calendar: instant acknowledgment, AI triage, a confirmed callback window instead of a dead widget.

prospects.trigger: They promise an Instant Online Quote, but the ServiceTitan scheduling embed fails with a JavaScript error on the live site.
prospects.gap: Make the stack they already pay for work for the customer: acknowledgment and triage in front of ServiceTitan so a failed widget is not a lost lead.

prospects.trigger: A 1974 company now part of the R&B Climate Control family, running a shared booking portal and using a gmail.com address as its main contact.
prospects.gap: Own the customer after the booking: branded acknowledgment, AI triage of the issue, estimate follow-up that does not run on a shared inbox.

prospects.trigger: Dated site with blank image panels and script errors: no form, no chat, and a Schedule Service button that just scrolls to the contact page.
prospects.gap: Basic intake that works: a form, an instant reply, a booking link - sold as fixing what is broken rather than replacing the business.

prospects.trigger: Already runs Housecall Pro booking and a Podium text-us widget, so the inbound inquiry gap is largely closed.
prospects.gap: Do not pitch intake. Pitch estimate follow-up: the quote that goes out and is never chased, which neither tool owns.

prospects.trigger: The copy promises live chat and online booking, neither exists as a working control, and the review score is 2.2.
prospects.gap: Low priority: reputation problem first. Courtesy pitch on response time only if they answer.
